profile.headline: Backend Software Engineer · LLM & Multi-Agent Systems
profile.summary: AWS/Azure-certified software engineer specializing in cloud technologies and AI. My background in creative technology brings a unique perspective to technical challenges. Proficient in full-stack development, I combine analytical thinking with creative problem-solving to build innovative solutions.

positions.title: Generative AI Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Designing and implementing multi-agent AI systems using the Strands Agents framework on AWS Bedrock with TypeScript and Python, powering Emergency Roadside Assistance workflows including towing dispatch, service requests, account signup, renewals, and payments.
-Engineered a multi-layer PII redaction pipeline combining AWS Guardrails, prompt-based filtering, and deterministic scrubbing to sanitize conversation data prior to logging.
-Built a RAG-based FAQ system enabling users to query general knowledge outside core ERS workflows using Anthropic and Amazon Nova models.
-Contributed to latency optimization by implementing ReWoo reasoning architecture, reducing LLM calls and cutting response latency by over 50%.
-Built comprehensive Splunk observability suite monitoring tool calls, LLM performance, API latency, and end-to-end flow success across agent workflows, and implemented agent evaluation frameworks for both development testing and production monitoring.
-Deploy and maintain serverless infrastructure across Lambda, Step Functions, AppSync/GraphQL, DynamoDB, and MongoDB.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon Bedrock · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · AI Agents · AWS Lambda · Back-End Web Development · TypeScript · Python (Programming Language) · MongoDB · Amazon Dynamodb · Splunk · Strands Agents

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Develop and maintain API integrations using Python in a .NET environment, working with Azure-based Kubernetes architecture
-Built proof-of-concept RAG-based AI assistant using OpenAI API, Langchain, and Pinecone vector database, integrating with Slack for internal knowledge sharing
-Implement site reliability engineering practices, including monitoring, alerting, and performance optimization for distributed systems utilizing SQL and KQL
-Perform comprehensive root cause analysis and complex troubleshooting in distributed systems as part of site reliability responsibilities
-Build and maintain Twilio integration services and supporting infrastructure
-Create technical documentation and example code implementations for API functionality
-Lead technical initiatives for system reliability improvements and API functionality expansion
-Engineer solutions for complex technical challenges in collaboration with backend development team

projects.title: Elonius- SMS AI Chatbot with Twilio and OpenAI
projects.description:
This project is a SMS-based chatbot application for conversational responses from AI Elon Musk. The user is able to communicate with the AI Elon Musk through text message.
-Server constructed with Node and Express
-Tunneling accomplished with ngrok generated URL
-CMS implementation with Twilio webhook
-AI functionality produced with the OpenAI API

projects.title: Bad Bank
projects.description:
Full stack banking web application that allows users to log in, check their balance, and deposit/withdraw fake money.
- Frontend implemented with React
- Backend constructed with Node and Express
- Leveraged Google Firebase for authentication
- Employed MongoDB for database
- Deployed on Heroku
